researchQuestion: Does unhedged repricing structure explain when rate shocks transmit into debt-service pressure beyond the level of policy/risk-free rates?
mechanism: Floating-rate debt transmits benchmark-rate changes into cash interest faster, subject to reset terms/floors/caps and hedges.
Fixed-rate debt suppresses immediate cash-flow pass-through but can create a refinancing cliff when low-cost fixed debt matures.
Hedges transform rather than erase exposure; hedge notional, term, counterparty and accounting designation must be separated.

evidenceAndCounterevidence.support: Firm-level research finds more unhedged floating-rate bank debt increases sensitivity of cash flows/investment and equity to monetary tightening.
evidenceAndCounterevidence.counter: Cash buffers, hedges, pricing power and falling benchmark rates can offset exposure.

evidenceAndCounterevidence.support: Official TSMC disclosure states a majority of debt is fixed-rate, limiting immediate debt cash-flow sensitivity to rate changes.
evidenceAndCounterevidence.counter: That does not remove rollover risk at maturity.

evidenceAndCounterevidence.support: Official UMC disclosure distinguishes fixed-rate bonds from floating-rate bank loans.
evidenceAndCounterevidence.counter: A fixed/floating percentage alone is insufficient without reset/maturity/hedge timing.

pitContract: Record debt principal by fixed/floating state at first-known statement date.
For floating debt preserve index, spread, reset frequency, floor/cap and next reset date when disclosed.
For fixed debt preserve maturity and callable/puttable terms.
Record swaps/hedges separately and compute unhedged exposure only when notional/maturity relationship is evidenced.
Unknown reset/hedge details remain UNKNOWN, never assumed fully floating or fully hedged.
falsificationGates: Floating-rate share != directional stock signal; effect depends on rate move direction, earnings sensitivity and liquidity.
Fixed-rate debt != low risk; maturity can convert it into D22-04 refinancing exposure.
Do not count the same benchmark-rate move already owned by D13 as an independent signal.
D22-08 owns exposure/transmission; D22-04 owns replacement cost; D22-01 owns maturity amount/timing.
If exposure structure adds no incremental information after those controls, classify REJECTED_OR_REDUNDANT.
next: Build Taiwan PIT fixed/floating/reset/hedge receipts across multiple non-financial issuers and dates.
Construct unhedged repricing-principal measures with explicit UNKNOWN handling.
Test rate-rise and rate-fall regimes separately before any L4 claim.
